name: DriX H-8 (Exail)
notes: Exail DriX H-8 medium-range USV. DIESEL-POWERED (single 38 HP diesel, straight shaft + fixed-pitch prop, 250 L fuel @ ~2 L/h -> multi-day endurance), NOT battery-propelled. OFFICIAL SPECS (Exail / naval-technology): LOA 7.71 m, beam 0.824 m, draft 2.0 m, 1,380 kg / 1.4 t, max 14 kn, survey/operating 7 kn, loiter 4 kn, 180 deg turn ~17 yd @ 14 kn (~8-10 m radius, matches the training notes' ~10 m). DOC-DERIVED (DriX Supervisor Training Notes): 24 V 5 Ah lithium service battery -> battery banding; ~1 kW payload. ESTIMATED: above-water windage height, autopilot gains, search-pattern sizes, drain model, spawn. max_turn_rate_deg_s (20) is chosen to give ~10 m turn radius at the 7 kn survey speed (the sim models a constant yaw-rate cap, not a constant min radius). The battery block models the 24 V service bank for the sim's gauge only; propulsion endurance is diesel/fuel-limited.
